use_when: 如何实现碰一碰导航流转至车机
如何实现上车自动导航流转
如何实现下车后导航自动流转回手机步行导航
如何实现地址文本碰一碰流转至车机地图
如何监听HiCar的连接状态变化
如何主动获取HiCar的连接状态
如何让超级桌面应用接入车机的分布式相机
如何配置Car Kit的编译模式和权限
当你的应用是导航类应用，需要实现手机与车机之间的导航信息无缝流转时（如碰一碰导航流转到车机、上车自动流转导航、下车后自动流转回手机步行导航），可以接入Car Kit的导航类接口
当你的应用需要在鸿蒙智行车机或HiCar认证车机上使用（如通过超级桌面将手机应用投屏到车机中控屏），或者需要使用车机摄像头等硬件能力时，可以接入Car Kit的出行互联类接口
接入车机导航续接，让手机路线自动切到中控屏继续导航 / Integrate in-car navigation handoff so a phone route continues on the head unit
实现离车后导航回流到手机并切换为步行接续 / Implement navigation return to the phone after leaving the car with walking continuation
把应用通过超级桌面投到车机屏幕显示和交互 / Project the app to the car display via Super Device for in-car interaction
订阅车机连接与断连事件以更新应用状态 / Subscribe to car connection and disconnection events to update app state
获取当前是否已连接HiCar或鸿蒙智行车机 / Get whether the device is currently connected to HiCar or a HarmonyOS vehicle
发送目的地到车机地图并在车端直接发起导航 / Send a destination to the car map and start navigation on the vehicle side
实现手机和车机之间的路线信息无缝同步 / Implement seamless route synchronization between phone and car
接入车机分布式摄像头，在车端使用车辆摄像头能力 / Integrate the car's distributed camera to use vehicle camera capabilities in the app
在应用上车时自动拉起车机端导航会话 / Automatically start the in-car navigation session when entering the vehicle
管理车机场景下的权限、编译配置和能力声明 / Manage permissions, build configuration, and capability declarations for car scenarios
让地址卡片或地点详情一碰即流转到车机导航 / Transfer an address card or place details to car navigation with touch-based handoff
适配HiCar认证车机，使应用可在车载中控环境运行 / Adapt the app for HiCar-certified vehicles so it can run in the in-car console environment
do_not_use_when: 应用只需要普通手机内导航、定位或路线规划，不涉及手机与车机之间的流转或HiCar连接 / The app only needs on-phone navigation, location, or route planning and does not involve phone-to-car transfer or HiCar connectivity
目标设备不是鸿蒙智行车机或HiCar认证车机，无法提供车机场景能力 / The target device is not a HarmonyOS Smart Cockpit vehicle unit or a HiCar-certified head unit, so in-car capabilities are unavailable

需求仅是通用跨设备文件、数据或页面流转，而不是车机导航流转、车机屏幕共享或车载硬件接入 / The requirement is only generic cross-device file, data, or page transfer rather than in-car navigation handoff, car-screen sharing, or vehicle hardware access
preconditions: 工程已按开发准备完成Car Kit相关编译模式、能力和依赖配置 / The project has completed the required Car Kit build mode, capability, and dependency configuration
应用已在module.json5中声明使用Car Kit所需的相关权限 / The app has declared the permissions required by Car Kit in module.json5
用户侧存在可用的车机连接环境，且目标车机支持鸿蒙智行或HiCar能力 / A usable in-vehicle connection environment exists and the target vehicle unit supports HarmonyOS Smart Cockpit or HiCar capabilities
inputs: 导航目的地或路线信息 / navigation destination or route information
地址文本或地址结构化数据 / address text or structured address data
HiCar连接状态查询或监听请求 / HiCar connection status query or listener request
车机屏幕信息或分布式相机能力请求 / car screen information or distributed camera capability request

postconditions.statement: 已接入Car Kit相关接口或事件监听，用于导航流转、HiCar状态获取/监听或超级桌面车机能力访问 / Car Kit APIs or event listeners are integrated for navigation handoff, HiCar status query/listening, or Super Desktop in-car capability access
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set add or modify code/config to call Car Kit APIs or register Car Kit listeners for navigation transfer, HiCar connection status, or Super Desktop vehicle capabilities?

postconditions.statement: 已补充Car Kit所需的权限、能力或编译配置 / The required Car Kit permissions, capabilities, or build configuration have been added
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set update module.json5, build profiles, or related configuration to declare permissions/capabilities/build settings needed for Car Kit?

postconditions.statement: 业务流程已根据车机连接或流转事件进行响应处理 / The business flow now handles vehicle connection state or transfer events appropriately
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set include logic branches, callbacks, or handlers that respond to car connection state changes or navigation transfer events?
